concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: Kira Wallet original companion character, high-quality Korean webtoon character illustration for a light app interface.
Input image role: the attached Moon Librarian is an identity and palette reference. Transform its 3D clay chibi rendering into a polished TWO-DIMENSIONAL WEBTOON character, no 3D rendering.
Story context: Kira is a warm, curious young adult research assistant who carefully checks evidence and records missing information. Friendly intelligence and gentle confidence, quiet warmth.
Identity lockstring: Kira, original young adult female celestial researcher, soft lavender chin-length bob with one curved side fringe, dark violet expressive eyes, small asymmetrical brass crescent hair clip, warm ivory short hooded cape with pale apricot lining over a simple cream blouse and lavender skirt, lavender crossbody research pouch, small closed lavender notebook.
Character proportions: clearly young adult, tasteful stylized modern Korean webtoon proportions approximately five heads tall, slightly large expressive face, slender compact figure, ordinary hands and short ivory boots. Cute and approachable with restrained detail. Not a toddler, not super-deformed chibi.
Scene: one full-body character in relaxed three-quarter front pose, hugging her closed notebook lightly with one hand and touching its edge with the other, small sincere smile. Face is the visual focus.
Style/medium: excellent Korean webtoon / manhwa character art, beautiful crisp fine dark-plum ink outlines with controlled line weight, clean flat color fills, two-step CEL SHADING, subtle soft blush and carefully drawn luminous eyes. Light airy sophisticated visual storytelling. The silhouette must read cleanly at app sizes. Absolutely 2D drawn illustration, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO clay, NO fabric simulation, NO volumetric studio lighting.
Color palette: ivory #F6EAD1, muted lavender #7762D5, apricot #F3C89E, dark plum #352D48. Keep the crescent and notebook as identity anchors.
Composition: single figure isolated and centered, entire body and feet visible, generous TRANSPARENT background and clean alpha edges, no ground or glow halo.
Avoid: dramatic weapons, coins, crypto logos, charts, text, labels, watermarks, extra characters, furry or clay textures, any backdrop, floor, smoke, aura, global bloom. Original character, no imitation of a named artist or existing IP.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Kira Wallet companion, polished adult woman webtoon illustration, one transparent waist-up character portrait suitable for a quiet light-theme research app.
Input references: Image 1 is a STYLE/MOOD reference for delicate expressive pen lines, messy elegant grown-woman hairstyle and a thoughtful bookish mood. Image 2 is a STYLE/MOOD reference for chic relaxed adult femininity, understated cuteness and softly shaded webtoon facial drawing. Draw a NEW ORIGINAL CHARACTER rather than reproducing either face or composition. DO NOT use the prior fantasy or chibi Kira design.
Primary request: clearly ADULT WOMAN age 28 to 32, chic, intelligent, quietly cute, a slightly playful but composed research companion. Mature facial proportions with a defined gentle jaw, normal-size almond eyes, refined brows, small natural lips and a knowing subtle half-smile. She must read as an adult colleague, never a teenage girl or child.
Identity lockstring: Kira, original 30-year-old female researcher; dark espresso-brown shoulder-length hair gathered into a relaxed low bun with long loose side strands and a soft side part; gray-violet almond-shaped eyes with calm slightly half-lidded gaze; ivory open-collar shirt, oversized charcoal blazer with sleeves casually pushed up, a slim dark watch, a very small muted-lavender notebook held loosely at her waist. Her signature accent is the notebook, not fantasy costume.
Pose/expression: relaxed waist-up three-quarter portrait, head gently tilted, one hand lightly touching her temple or tucking a loose hair strand behind her ear, the other holding the small notebook. A soft closed-mouth asymmetrical smile, poised and friendly without exaggerated excitement. Neck and shoulders fully visible. Adult anatomy and normal head-to-shoulder proportions.
Style/medium: high-quality contemporary 2D Korean webtoon illustration, fine expressive dark ink lines with subtle sketch-like strand detail, crisp readable face and silhouette, soft muted flat colors and restrained watercolor/cel shadows. Delicate naturally drawn hair and clothing folds. Elegant editorial character art, airy and warm. No 3D rendering.
Palette: espresso hair, charcoal blazer, ivory shirt, warm natural skin, tiny muted lavender accent, soft neutral shadows. Use the restrained cream/ink warmth of reference 1 with the chic facial attitude of reference 2.
Composition: single character, waist-up portrait including both hands and notebook, centered with generous transparent padding. FULLY TRANSPARENT background with clean alpha edges. No glow, haze, aura, shadow plane, bookshelves or scene. Any pixel outside the character silhouette should be transparent.
Avoid: chibi proportions, oversized eyes or head, childlike cheeks, school uniform, necktie, cape, hood, princess or magical-girl outfit, crescent decorations, sparkles, weapons, band-aids, extreme cleavage, coins, charts, cryptocurrency logos, text, labels, watermark, busy scenery.
concepts.review: Adult proportions, shirt and blazer, calm gaze, notebook anchor. Current provisional demo direction; no claim of an approved final character.
